name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.189: The unsynchronized original is no longer an archive but a sidecar you can select
    in the player, and it is locked against upload. After a correction the untouched file lands
    beside the corrected one as <base>.<lang>.99.srt — numbered from 99 downward — so Jellyfin
    lists it as its own track. The slots 90-99 are reserved for it, which is why corrected files
    now stop at slot 89: without that cap a corrected file could be handed the name of an original
    and overwrite the very file the correction exists to keep. No new state and no new rejection
    reason were introduced — the original is registered exactly as every downloaded subtitle
    already is, which is what keeps it out of the queue and out of the upload. The archive
    (<name>.srt.unsynced.zip) is no longer written; archives already on disk are left untouched.
